attributes.name: Old Salt's Rapier +2
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 2d4+2; you may additionally discard this card to add another 3d4 and the Acid trait. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

Recharge this card to add the Swashbuckling trait to or ignore it on your check; this does not count as playing a weapon.
